hooks.command: c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); [ -n "$c" ] || exit 0; if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qiE "rm[[:space:]]+-[a-z]*(rf|fr)[a-z]*[[:space:]]+(/([[:space:]]|$)|~/?([[:space:]]|$)|\*|\.([[:space:]]|$))|DROP[[:space:]]+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA)|TRUNCATE[[:space:]]"; then echo "BLOCKED: destructive command. Ask the user to run it themselves." >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push" && printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "[[:space:]](-f|--force)([[:space:]]|$)" && printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]:+])(main|master)([[:space:]]|$)"; then echo "BLOCKED: force-push to main. Never rewrite shared history." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
